author: agent
sentences: People ask how I edit so quickly, so here is the honest answer.
I keep every project in the same folder layout.
Each week I spend about 20 minutes on captions and $15 a month on music.
Everything else is templates I made once and reuse.
The real speed comes from deciding before I open the editor.
notes: 20 minutes and $15 a month are two quantities of unrelated units in one sentence: no change from one to the other, and neither is a figure a person would animate in this aside. The plan's example was $5,000 on gear and 20 hours of setup; a person would expect $5,000 to be animated, which the row's no-event rule forbids, so smaller everyday amounts are used
